scope: One input-delivery and artifact check per product, engineering track; T03-M formal admission is unchanged.
allowed_modes: Native client work surface or official CLI. Any fallback surface is labeled and its local/cloud boundary remains separate.
input: input.csv bytes as an attachment or at the root of a fresh external workspace; do not inline values.
success: Parse receipt.json or native final response JSON independently. Exact expected type and values against input CSV. Chat and artifact recorded separately. No result or no trace is unknown.
timing: Target 180 seconds per product after admission; keep each product session serial.
